inputs.original_text: Health workers took their opposition to proposed reform bills to Unity Fountain in Maitama on Thursday, but street pressure should not dictate national policy. The National Assembly must judge the bills on their merits and put patients and the country’s long-term welfare ahead of union interests. A strained health sector needs responsible reform, not the preservation of arrangements simply because powerful groups resist change.
inputs.modified_text: Health workers may have concerns, but taking them to the streets at Unity Fountain in Maitama should not give unions a veto over national policy. The National Assembly has a duty to weigh the proposed reform bills in the national interest, putting patients and the country’s long-term welfare above organized pressure. A strained health sector needs responsible reform; preserving the status quo just because powerful groups resist change serves neither patients nor the country.
